purpose: Single-seed development experiment, not a replacement for the publication main table
data_protocol: Released train/valid partition and all 150 official negatives. Official train bidirection retained. Reverse-exposed validation positives are separately reported; no test performance accessed.
selection: best full validation MRR; also final and clean diagnostic slice reported
fixed_comparison: The pair arms share initialization, sampled positives, negatives, walk seeds, budget and backbone; only the cross-endpoint witness score is enabled in pair_joint.
stop_policy: Respect STOP_REQUESTED and absolute budget.json deadline. Skip completed trials; never reset the budget or silently restart a partly completed baseline.
